name: Scapula halo track: J1 is a closed cam track on low-motion scapula skin and the J2 hub rides it
family: spherical 3R, track base (J1 = carriage on a closed non-circular scapula track)
verdict: Not worth a GPU sweep as it stands (gap 87.6 vs the baseline's 68.9). The track itself is 80 % in band. But the loop that stays on in-band scapula skin closes only 64.5 % of poses, and the rigid link 2 (scapula to arm) is 14 % in band.
note: Bench(60,160) fast. Best: thr ib100 (bench in-band loop), W (100,-15), a2 75, sigma -1, q 1.0, closed. Track 51-65 mm, J2 eye 74.7 mm, J3 disc 71.9 mm. The bogie pitch pivot and the 13 mm J2 radial slide are cam-set passive elements (determined by s), not counted. Red team: jam at Reach high shelf (|cos phi| 0.20); pinch 1.9 mm at the carriage (plane 45 elev 30); the loop's smallest turning radius is 8.7 mm, too tight for a 20 mm bogie.

2R spherical shoulder + C-ring axial bearing on the upper arm
verdict: dead: gap 129.98 vs 68.93 for the spherical 3R on the same bench (25 configurations); not worth a GPU sweep - the limiter is structural: the C-track's carriage must travel ~220 deg round the arm (axial rotation turns p2's azimuth 1:1) but a circular track about any GH-through humerus-fixed axis hugs the arm only over its lateral +-60 deg
note: best = sweep entry 8; Bench(60,160) fast grid cache, kit conventions (march, K2 dense, K6 + by-construction track/carriage/slide), audit clean; branch sigma -1 essential (sigma +1: links 0 in band); red team: rest taken 2.7 mm, overhead contact hub1 -6.0 mm, abd75+ext90 / int90 jam (carriage outside C), across-body taken 5.5 mm, behind-back taken 1.3 mm; pinches link2 0.26 mm, track 0.31 mm; cam-track variant indicative only (track in-band 0.88, contact in most poses); baseline 3R 68.93 | limiter: axial travel vs circular track: required track radius (median / p90 pose) 49/57 mm for a +-60 deg span vs 73/87 mm for the +-110 deg the carriage needs (L=100); best (cov 0.6, R 57) loses 75/89 lost ws poses and 11/16 lost clip frames to 'carriage outside the C' (abduction 75 with +-90 axial rotation jams), track in-band14 0.13, carriage 0.00; full C (cov 0.95) R 86.5, contact 0.80. Overhead (plane 30 elev 150): hub 1 6 mm inside the skin. Spec fix: the GH-elbow line runs 3-8 mm under the skin at mid-arm and exits overhead, so the track axis is tilted 18 deg

name: Non-spherical offset 3R with passive self-aligning slides
verdict: not worth its own GPU sweep: net -0.84 gap vs the in-model spherical control with the same directions (57.95 vs 58.79, inside greedy-drop noise) - the slides cost 6.4, R1/R2 offsets buy back 7.3; the gain over the 68.93 baseline is the model's free-underside fit (62.58 at the champion directions) and a direction re-tune that belongs to the spherical family (hand d_el -6.4, d_wd +4.1, d_wa +3.6 to its GPU sweep)
note: spec fixed: 3 passive translations, not 2 (3R+2P cannot close on a 3-DOF arm with offset axes; R3-only offsets are the exact exception and score 65.4); best = remote slide stage 5 mm past hub 3 with a ramped neck, all six offsets, re-tuned directions; numbers under jam_contact=1 (before the fix the same config read 49.15 because jams hid contact); pinch: link 1 0.43 mm at plane 15 elev 0 axial -75; bench fast Bench(60,160)
